messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: VPC egress error spike detected — us-west-2a prod subnets. Metric: outbound_5xx_rate > 25% for 3m. Affected target: natgw-prod-usw2a (health failing). Incident: INC-1935001111. https://alerts.redwood.internal/INC-1935001111

maya (SRE): Paging @liam oncall — multiple customers reporting outbound failures, started ~06:04 UTC. 5xx on https://api.redwood.ai/outbound.

liam (oncall): I'm awake, joining. watching logs now. taking pager.

samir (netops): I'm looking at VPC console + CloudTrail. I see a RouteTableAssociation change at 06:02:43 UTC — rtb-0a1b2c3d re-associated from subnet-prod-az2 to subnet-prod-db-az2 (unexpected). Change created by terraform apply from ci-runner-42.

maya (SRE): that sounds bad — if DB subnet got the egress route that points to a NAT in a different AZ that could cause asymmetric returns. can you paste the route table entries?

samir (netops): paste below:
```
RouteTable rtb-0a1b2c3d
  10.0.0.0/16 local
  0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0f6e5d4c (natgw-prod-usw2a) (state: unhealthy)
  10.100.0.0/16 -> vpc-peering-123
```
Associated subnets: subnet-prod-db-az2 (expected: subnet-prod-az2)

liam (oncall): nat-0f6e5d4c is showing failing healthchecks across all IPs; logs: NAT dropped connections with RST — likely asymmetric or unhealthy instance behind GW.

olivia (support): Support has 12 customers flagged via Sentry + 3 support tickets opened. Most report outbound connections failing (webhooks, third-party APIs). ETA for escalation: immediate.

jo (product): flagging customer-impact — high for those with webhook batches. We'll prepare status note once we have ETA.

maya (SRE): mitigation plan: 1) re-associate rtb-0a1b2c3d back to correct subnet-prod-az2 2) if NAT remains unhealthy, failover traffic to standby NAT in AZ-b 3) temp route to IGW if safe for that subnet 4) rollback offending terraform change. Execute steps and comment on thread.

liam (oncall): re-associating route table now (manual to avoid another tf run). running: aws ec2 associate-route-table --subnet-id subnet-prod-az2 --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3d

deploy-bot: associate-route-table completed: assoc-rtb-7890 at 06:11:02 UTC

samir (netops): association shows correct now. doing health check on natgw-prod-usw2a — still failing. I can trigger failover to natgw-standby-usw2b.

liam (oncall): creating temp route for subnet-prod-az2 to IGW to restore outbound (this allows direct egress while we fail NAT). note: this opens outbound, checked with security team — acceptable for short window.

samir (netops): adding route: aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3d --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --gateway-id igw-0d4c3b2a

samir (netops): route replaced to IGW at 06:14:30 UTC. Observability: egress success rate climbed to 95% within 90s.

olivia (support): Confirmed: customer calls dropping to zero in last 2 mins for those we called. I'll update tickets + send interim advisory that we're mitigating and will follow with root cause.

liam (oncall): starting NAT failover: de-registering nat-0f6e5d4c from target group and spinning up replacement nat-0a9b8c7d in us-west-2b.

deploy-bot: NAT replacement ami build started; instance nat-0a9b8c7d provisioning complete at 06:22:01 UTC.

samir (netops): re-pointing route back to NAT standby now: replace-route -> nat-0a9b8c7d.

deploy-bot: replace-route completed at 06:23:10 UTC. Health checks passing for nat-0a9b8c7d.

liam (oncall): removing temp IGW route and re-enabling NAT egress policies. remove route -> IGW at 06:25:05 UTC.

maya (SRE): monitoring: outbound 5xx back to baseline within 3m of IGW route, and sustained with standby NAT after cutover. marking incident as mitigated.

incident-bot: Severity -> P1 (initial), reduced to P2 at 06:28:00 UTC after mitigation.

olivia (support): Sent interim advisory to affected customers at 06:31 UTC. No SLA breaches reported yet; tracking support escalation list.

jo (product): preparing short customer-facing note + internal postmortem request. Please file root cause postmortem and include terraform change id and CI job info.

maya (SRE): immediate action items: samir to collect CloudTrail + TF plan for the apply that re-associated route table; liam to write mitigation timeline; olivia to collect impacted customer list and support threads. handoff to samir for RCA.

samir (netops): I'll own RCA. Preliminary note: terraform run from pipeline `infra-network-ci/runner-42` applied association that targeted the wrong subnet due to a variable mismatch. will attach plan & CI logs to postmortem.

liam (oncall): leaving detailed timeline in the incident doc and creating follow-up PR to add a guard to TF that prevents cross-attach of rtb to db subnets.

maya (SRE): thanks — handing off to post-incident. If anything regresses ping this thread. closing oncall for now. :white_check_mark:
